MVRV_zscore at 23 vs 40 at the actual bottom (-17 diff) confirms we're not at max-pain accumulation. VIX at 68 vs 38 then (+30) shows macro fear is elevated but not translating to crypto panic. Fed_liquidity at 0 is a massive current-only anchor keeping us pinned.
